summary.title: Summaries
summary.autoContinueDescription: Continue drafts that reached the output limit before the next completion. Cancelled drafts and drafts put aside with Later stay paused.
summary.historyDescription: Uses plain conversation text through the second-latest character response. Images and other data sources are excluded. Local summarization temporarily replaces the model’s active context; saved chat KV files are preserved.
summary.disabled: Enable summaries in Data Sources to generate and use them.
summary.paused: Automatic summaries are paused until this draft is resolved.
summary.sourceChanged: Source history changed. Save to keep this summary, or regenerate it.
summary.noStats: No prompt has been built yet.
summary.deleteConfirm: Delete this summary? The original chat history is retained.
summary.minimumHistoryDescription: Jumlah token sumber minimum sebagai persentase kapasitas prompt setelah token balasan dicadangkan. Ringkasan otomatis menunggu jika rentang yang dibatasi lebih kecil.
summary.maximumCoverageDescription: Ringkas hingga persentase ini dari riwayat yang belum diringkas dan masih muat dalam konteks, agar dialog terbaru tetap utuh.
summary.consolidateDescription: Gabungkan ringkasan lama saat mendominasi konteks dan riwayat mentah yang memenuhi syarat terlalu sedikit. Pemadatan berulang dapat menghilangkan detail.
summary.compressionFallback: Sampai draf ini diselesaikan, balasan menggunakan ringkasan yang diterima dan riwayat yang masih muat.

contextAllocation.title: Context allocation
contextAllocation.estimateDescription: Current context estimate using saved token counts and text lengths.
contextAllocation.opportunisticDescription: Lorebook budgets are limits, not fixed reservations. Matching entries and examples may use free space when the prompt is built.
